data.title: Bathroom Design & Layout Available let's Build
data.description:
Complete Luxury Bathroom Renovation & Remodeling
We bring your vision to life! If you already have your preferred bathroom layout and design ready, our expert team is here to execute it with absolute precision and flawless finish. From complete demolition and structural waterproofing to high-end tiling, bespoke vanity installation, and concealed plumbing/electrical setups, we ensure every detail matches your design specification.
2. Detailed Scope of Work (Service Breakdown)
(Agar design approval ke baad detailed work scope bhejni ho)
1. Demolition & Site Preparation
Safe demolition of existing wall & floor tiles, ceiling, and sanitary fixtures.
Complete site cleanup and ethical disposal of debris/wastage.
2. Waterproofing & Sub-floor Preparation
Floor screeding and wall leveling with heavy-duty plaster mesh.
Application of premium-grade waterproofing systems (e.g., Mapei system) with a 48-hour leak-testing period prior to tile laying.
3. Precision Tiling & Masonry
Alignment and installation of client-selected wall and floor tiles using high-bond adhesives and epoxy grout.
Clean corner edging, tile clips, and integrated floor drain trap installations.
4. Custom Vanity & Countertop Installation
Custom fabrication and installation of waterproof MDF vanities (floating/wall-mounted with soft-close drawers).
Marble or stone countertop integration with precision basin cutouts and bottle trap plumbing.
5. Plumbing, Electrical & Sanitary Fixtures
Complete renewal of water supply (PPR piping) and drainage lines.
Concealed WC frame installation, wall-hung toilet setup, shattaf, and premium shower mixers.
Point-to-point concealed electrical wiring for LED corner profiles, recessed ceiling lights, and illuminated vanity mirrors.
6. Custom Glass & Recessed Niche Design
Custom built-in wall niches (in shower & WC areas) built as per approved design dimensions.
10mm tempered glass shower partition with stainless steel (Grade 314) hardware and silicone sealing.
7. Moisture-Resistant Gypsum Ceiling
Installation of 12mm moisture-resistant green gypsum false ceiling with shadow angles.
Smooth 2-coat stucco jointing, primer, and premium paint finish.

data.title: DEWA ELECTRICAL PROJECT
data.scope: Main Line Cabel Pulling in Microsoft Data Center
data.description:
Site Preparation & Safety Setup:
​Setting up safety barricades, warning signs, and site safety controls prior to excavation.

​Review and verification of NOCs and existing underground utility drawings.

​Trench Excavation & Route Preparation:
​Manual and mechanical excavation of cable trenches as per DEWA approved depth, width, and route drawings.
​Shoring and dewatering (if required based on site ground conditions).

​Sand Bedding & Ducting:
​Supply and laying of a 100mm sweet sand bedding at the bottom of the trench prior to cable placement.
​Installation of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) / UPVC heavy-duty ducts/conduits at road crossings and concrete entries.

​Cable Pulling & Laying:
​Transportation, handling, and mounting of cable drums on jack stands.

​Pulling and laying of Low Voltage (LV) / Medium Voltage (MV) armored power cables using cable rollers, pulling winches, and tension-monitoring mechanisms to prevent cable jacket damage.

​Cable Protection & Backfilling:
​Application of a top cover of 100mm sweet sand directly over the laid cables.

​Installation of concrete cable protection tiles/covers along the cable route.

​Laying of high-visibility yellow electrical warning tape above the sand bed layer.
​Layer-by-layer backfilling using approved soil material followed by proper compaction.

​Testing & Handover:
​Pre-laying and post-laying insulation resistance (Megger) testing and continuity checks.

​Preparation and submission of As-Built drawings and route markers for final authority/consultant approval.
